name: Knead
description: The first clip is kneaded like dough: its two halves squeeze and slide past each other into two rows, again and again, until the picture is drawn out into thin layers; the layers of the second clip are pressed in between them, then the second clip is unkneaded back into one picture. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: kneads
params.description: Number of kneads on each side (each one stacks the picture into twice as many layers)

params.name: shadow
params.description: Depth of the shading on the layers and of the shadow the sliding half casts

params.name: back_color
params.description: Color seen in the corners the halves uncover while they slide
